shadows.name: surface-lift
shadows.purpose: Focal map cards and verified media.

motion.name: route-draw

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The high-contrast action used for the primary profile route.
components.css: .ds-action-primary { min-height: 46px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: .65rem 1rem; color: var(--paper, #f4f1e8); background: var(--ink, #11120f); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #11120f); font-family: var(--display, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-action-primary:hover { background: var(--cobalt, #124fd4); border-color: var(--cobalt, #124fd4); } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cobalt, #124fd4); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Profile Station
components.description: A bordered destination connected to the profile route map.
components.css: .ds-station { min-height: 78px; display: grid; align-content: center; gap: .1rem; padding: .7rem .9rem .75rem 1.15rem; color: var(--cobalt, #124fd4); background: var(--paper-raised, #fffdf6); border: 1px solid currentColor; font-family: var(--display, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-station strong { font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-station small { color: var(--muted, #555c55); font-family: var(--body, 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif); } .ds-station:hover { color: var(--paper, #f4f1e8); background: var(--cobalt, #124fd4); } .ds-station:hover small { color: var(--paper, #f4f1e8); } .ds-station:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cobalt, #124fd4); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Projects Disclosure
components.description: A native no-JavaScript route menu for every project.
components.css: .ds-case-menu { font-family: var(--display, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif); } .ds-case-menu summary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; } .ds-case-menu a { min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: .65rem; color: var(--ink, #11120f); background: var(--paper-raised, #fffdf6); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #c7cbc3); text-decoration: none; } .ds-case-menu summary:hover, .ds-case-menu a:hover { color: var(--cobalt, #124fd4); } .ds-case-menu summary:focus-visible, .ds-case-menu a:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cobalt, #124fd4); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Command Search
components.description: The square high-contrast search field inside the optional command palette.
components.css: .ds-command-search { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: .7rem; color: var(--ink, #11120f); background: var(--paper, #f4f1e8); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #11120f); border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--body, 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif); } .ds-command-search:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cobalt, #124fd4); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Case Progress Link
components.description: A numbered reading destination in the case-study progress spine.
components.css: .ds-progress { min-height: 52px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.5rem 1fr; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; color: var(--ink, #11120f); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #c7cbc3); font-family: var(--display, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif); font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-progress span { color: var(--cobalt, #124fd4); } .ds-progress:hover { color: var(--cobalt, #124fd4); } .ds-progress:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cobalt, #124fd4); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio borrows the clarity and confidence of contemporary civic wayfinding. A warm enamel-paper field, compressed destination type, functional route colors, and connected station geometry turn personal positioning into a navigable system rather than a conventional marketing hero. The system is direct, technical, and readable. Large headings establish destinations while Source Sans 3 carries evidence at comfortable line lengths. Project routes reduce the map into a calmer reading mode so the visual identity supports, rather than competes with, engineering detail.
keyCharacteristics: Functional route colors with stable semantic roles.
Condensed destination typography paired with humanist body copy.
Square, bordered surfaces and authored wayfinding geometry.
One expressive map surface; content pages remain quiet and linear.
Progressive enhancement, visible focus, and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Every route color names a destination or state; do not scatter accents decoratively.

rules.name: The Paper Ground Rule
rules.body: Enamel Paper is the default field. Raised Paper distinguishes bounded surfaces without changing the visual temperature.

rules.name: The Destination Type Rule
rules.body: Condensed display type names places and actions; it does not replace body copy.

rules.name: The Map Then Reading Rule
rules.body: Spatial composition introduces the profile; detailed content and case studies return to normal document flow.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use shadow only when a surface genuinely overlaps the map or document.

dos: Do use route colors consistently: Cobalt for Skills and interaction, Green for Background, Orange for Learnings, and Carbon for Target.
Do keep homepage profile facts in profile.ts and project evidence in projects.ts.
Do preserve semantic links, native disclosures, visible focus, and readable content without client JavaScript.
Do disable route drawing and reveal transitions under reduced-motion preferences.
Do reserve the two-axis grid and connected route geometry for a genuine map surface.
donts: Don't place project showcases, project evidence, or case-study cards in the homepage body.
Don't shrink the desktop map onto mobile; translate it into the ordered vertical route.
Don't use gradients, rounded app-shell cards, or decorative accent colors that have no route meaning.
Don't invent screenshots, metrics, employers, testimonials, or other credibility signals.
